accepted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: desktop game-world-selection background for the fictional cross-platform strategy game SHADOWGRID
Input images: Image 1 is the approved strategic-control architectural style reference; Image 2 is the approved registration material, daylight, and safe-area reference. Create a completely new scene.
Primary request: Create a premium ultra-realistic panoramic strategy observatory where a player could choose among fictional seasonal game worlds.
Scene/backdrop: an original contemporary top-floor civic-economic observation gallery in a fictional German metropolis, with dark stone, glass, brushed metal, distant plausible urban districts, and subtle abstract light channels suggesting interconnected regions without depicting an actual map or interface.
Subject: architecture and strategic scale only; no people, screens, labels, maps, or selectable UI elements embedded in the image.
Style/medium: ultra-realistic architectural photography; contemporary German urban economic-strategy atmosphere; cinematic corporate thriller; restrained subtle cyber-noir; physically plausible construction and reflections.
Composition/framing: exact 16:9 landscape intent, intended final size 2048x1152; human eye-level wide composition. Reserve the central 60% of the frame from about 12% to 90% height as a calm, dark, low-detail architectural surface for a wide world-selection form. Concentrate panoramic city depth, structural rhythm, and restrained gold/cool light at the far left and right. Keep the upper-left quiet for the existing brand. No bright horizon, mullion, furniture, light table, map line, or focal object may cross the central form-safe region.
Lighting/mood: clear early-evening blue hour with a subtle transition from cool exterior light to restrained warm-gold interior accents; expansive, anticipatory, credible, and calm.
Color palette: black and anthracite, cool blue-gray, restrained warm gold, muted stone and greenery; no saturated neon or warning red.
Materials/textures: physically plausible dark glass, brushed metal, concrete, stone, understated floor inlays, realistic scale and material imperfections.
Text: none.
Constraints: wholly original fictional location; no actual German map or geography; no people or faces; no text, fake writing, signage, screens, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, readable plates, addresses, flags, uniforms, authorities, weapons, crime symbols, or real brands. High readability under a centered wide UI overlay and robust cover-cropping at common desktop ratios.
Avoid: reproducing either reference composition, recognizable landmarks, copied photo angles, fantasy skyline, impossible geometry, excessive neon, sci-fi holograms, cartoon, anime, comic, plastic mobile-game rendering, blur, low resolution, compression artifacts.
notes: The wide central stone surface provides a clean safe area for world-selection controls.
Urban depth and restrained light remain at the outer edges without depicting a real map or interface.
No visible person, text, logo, private identifier, authority mark, weapon or illicit activity.
